title: Euler liars
statement: For natural numbers $N$ and $A$, say that $A$ is an Euler liar for $N$ if $A$ and $N$ are coprime and, in $\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$, the residue class of the Jacobi symbol $(A/N)$ equals the $(N-1)/2$-th power of the residue class of $A$.
